description: The plot illustrates the relationship between sample token count and shared experts for two experts across different tasks. The x-axis is labeled “Sample Token Count” and is a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2<sup>9</sup> to 2<sup>20</sup>, with tick labels at intervals of 2<sup>2</sup>. The y-axis is labeled “Shared Experts for Two Experts” and is a linear scale, ranging from 2.0 to 6.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. A blue line, representing “Intent”, begins at approximately 5.8 at 2<sup>9</sup>, declines to 3.2 at 2<sup>11</sup>, and then rises to approximately 5.6 at 2<sup>20</sup>. An orange line, representing “Summary”, starts at approximately 3.7 at 2<sup>9</sup>, declines to 3.1 at 2<sup>11</sup>, and then increases to approximately 5.4 at 2<sup>20</sup>. A yellow line, representing “Law”, begins at approximately 4.1 at 2<sup>9</sup>, declines to 3.4 at 2<sup>11</sup>, and then rises to approximately 5.5 at 2<sup>20</sup>. A gray line, representing “Translation”, starts at approximately 3.3 at 2<sup>9</sup>, declines to 2.8 at 2<sup>11</sup>, and then rises to approximately 5.3 at 2<sup>20</sup>. Finally, a green line, representing “Math”, begins at approximately 4.7 at 2<sup>9</sup>, declines to 3.9 at 2<sup>11</sup>, and then rises to approximately 5.5 at 2<sup>20</sup>.
